title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Walking Food, Wine or Beer Tasting Tour
includes: A local custom Tour Guide and Bar Server gratuity not included.
Minimum group of 2 required for tour to run. Minimum group of 4 guests 4:00 p.m., beer/cidar only (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please contact Host prior to booking if experiencing mobility concerns/injuries or needing a slower pace of walking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Old Town on a guided walking tour featuring comforting local favourites, savoury bites, sweet indulgances, as well as Tuscan Artisan gelato or pastry/cappuccino/coffee/tea and an exclusive tasting experience. Then, choose between a shareable beer flight at the iconic Prince of Wales or wine tasting experience in Niagara’s wine country (self-drive required, 10 min; transportation not included). A delicious and memorable way to experience the heart of Niagara with a local host.

Starting August 1st indulge in a delicious Potato Twister seasoned to perfection, Prociutto/meat/vegetarian Pannini, freshly made to order Apple Fritter, an exclusive tasting experience, your choice of freshly made Tuscan style gelato/pastry/cappucino/coffee/tea and walk into long standing candy shop for a delicious 'Old Time' treat! A delicious way to explore this charming heritage town.
